<includeonly></includeonly><noinclude>{{#cargo_declare:_table=ContainerDrops
|SourceItemKey=String
|DroppedItemKey=String
|DropProbability=Float
|IsGuaranteed=Boolean
}}
Declare-only owner of the <code>ContainerDrops</code> junction (one row per source item × produced item, for items that open into others, e.g. the Braxonian Fossil). <code>SourceItemKey</code> (the container) and <code>DroppedItemKey</code> (the produced item) are both StableKeys; <code>IsGuaranteed</code> marks that the source always yields one item from its pool. Rows are written by {{tl|Item}}, which <code>#cargo_attach</code>es this table; this template stores nothing itself.
</noinclude>
